notes.title: Bunnyrama Patch 81-85 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you for your patience and reports, there is no good excuse for such a long delay. This patch finally fixes Steam achievements on Windows (r85) and Mac (r81). Linux version will follow.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27140659/db00d0006f3bb5cfc58c034882f52d6c0bcf6b3e.png

notes.title: Bunnyrama Patch 81 for Mac OS released!
notes.content:
Please download latest patch to fix an issue with bonus levels (Mac only). Thanks to our players reports for finding the bug.

Starwind Games Team
